ward.summary: Grant Road, Malabar Hill, Tardeo (ward D) used ₹12.7 lakh of its ₹16.0 lakh budget, or 80%, staying within budget across 40 jobs. About 20% of repairs were redone within 30 days, against 23% expected for similar work, so durability is in line with expectations. The ₹2.4 lakh spent on repairs that failed is part of that picture. Two jobs are listed for review in billing. Next, the ward should fund 7 open issues costing ₹1.3 lakh, starting with potholes on Peddar Road and Tardeo Road and waterlogging at Pandita Ramabai Road. The remaining ₹3.3 lakh covers all of them.
